bamboo.name: Rumah Bambu
bamboo.description: Rumah tradisional berdinding anyaman bambu (gedek). Cepat dan hemat biaya untuk menampung warga perintis.
bamboo.description_en: Traditional home with woven bamboo walls. Fast and affordable shelter for early pioneer villagers.

wood_house.name: Rumah Kayu
wood_house.description: Rumah panggung kayu dengan sirkulasi udara alami yang sejuk dan konstruksi kokoh.
wood_house.description_en: Elevated timber house with cool natural ventilation and sturdy wood craftsmanship.

simple_house.name: Rumah Sederhana
simple_house.description: Rumah semi-permanen dengan lantai plester semen dan dinding papan rapi.
simple_house.description_en: Semi-permanent home with smooth concrete flooring and neatly paneled timber walls.

permanent.name: Rumah Permanen
permanent.description: Rumah bata merah beratap genting tanah liat. Tempat tinggal nyaman untuk keluarga mapan.
permanent.description_en: Permanent brick residence with terracotta roof tiles, offering comfortable long-term living.

housing.name: Perumahan
housing.description: Kawasan pemukiman tertata dengan halaman asri dan jalan lingkungan yang nyaman.
housing.description_en: Planned residential cluster with pleasant yards and convenient neighborhood pathways.

apartment.name: Apartemen
apartment.description: Hunian vertikal modern bertingkat yang menampung banyak warga di lahan terbatas.
apartment.description_en: Modern multi-story residential building housing many residents within a compact footprint.

condo.name: Kondominium
condo.description: Kondominium perkotaan dengan fasilitas lengkap dan hunian nyaman berstandar tinggi.
condo.description_en: Urban condominium with comprehensive amenities and upscale residential units.

rice_field.name: Sawah
rice_field.description: Petak sawah berteras untuk menanam padi. Kebutuhan pangan pokok bagi seluruh warga kampung.
rice_field.description_en: Terraced paddy field for growing rice, the essential staple food of the entire village.

corn_field.name: Kebun Jagung
corn_field.description: Kebun jagung tropis penghasil bulir jagung manis untuk konsumsi dan bahan pakan ternak.
corn_field.description_en: Tropical corn plantation producing sweet corn for resident food and livestock feed processing.

chili_field.name: Kebun Cabai
chili_field.description: Kebun cabai rawit pedas dengan nilai jual tinggi di pasar tradisional maupun pedagang kota.
chili_field.description_en: Spicy chili pepper plantation yielding high-value cash crops for traditional and city markets.

cassava_field.name: Kebun Singkong
cassava_field.description: Ladang singkong tahan kemarau penghasil umbi kaya karbohidrat untuk cadangan pangan.
cassava_field.description_en: Drought-resistant cassava patch yielding versatile carbohydrate-rich root crops.

banana_field.name: Kebun Pisang
banana_field.description: Kebun pisang tropis rimbun yang menghasilkan tandan buah manis sepanjang musim.
banana_field.description_en: Lush banana grove producing sweet tropical fruit bunches across all seasons.

coconut_field.name: Kebun Kelapa
coconut_field.description: Perkebunan kelapa dengan pohon menjulang tinggi penghasil buah serbaguna dan minyak.
coconut_field.description_en: Coconut grove with towering palms producing versatile coconuts for cooking, drinks and oil.

coffee_field.name: Kebun Kopi
coffee_field.description: Perkebunan kopi lereng bukit penghasil biji kopi berkualitas dengan aroma khas nusantara.
coffee_field.description_en: Hillside coffee plantation yielding premium coffee beans with distinct archipelago aroma.

chicken.name: Kandang Ayam
chicken.description: Kandang ayam kampung penghasil telur segar berprotein tinggi untuk kebutuhan warga.
chicken.description_en: Free-range chicken coop producing fresh, nutritious eggs for village households.

duck.name: Peternakan Bebek
duck.description: Peternakan bebek petelur dekat aliran air penghasil telur bebek berkualitas gurih.
duck.description_en: Duck farm situated near waterways producing savory, high-protein duck eggs.

goat.name: Peternakan Kambing
goat.description: Peternakan kambing peranakan etawa penghasil susu dan daging berkualitas tinggi.
goat.description_en: Goat farm producing high-quality meat and fresh milk for the community.

cow.name: Peternakan Sapi
cow.description: Peternakan sapi perah dan potong penghasil susu segar serta daging berkualitas.
cow.description_en: Cattle ranch producing fresh milk and quality meat, supporting dairy trade.

catfish.name: Kolam Lele
catfish.description: Kolam budidaya ikan lele air tawar dengan sistem bioflok yang cepat panen dan tahan penyakit.
catfish.description_en: Freshwater catfish aquaculture pond with efficient growth and resilient yields.

tilapia.name: Kolam Nila
tilapia.description: Kolam air tawar jernih untuk budidaya ikan nila kaya nutrisi bagi pasar lokal.
tilapia.description_en: Clean freshwater pond culturing nutritious tilapia fish for local dining and market trade.

warung.name: Warung
warung.description: Warung kopi dan kelontong bersahaja tempat warga mengobrol santai dan membeli kebutuhan harian.
warung.description_en: Modest village coffee stall and sundries counter where neighbors gather and shop daily.

shop.name: Toko Kelontong
shop.description: Toko kelontong serba ada yang menyediakan sembako dan perlengkapan rumah tangga.
shop.description_en: General merchandise shop supplying grocery staples and everyday household goods.

market.name: Pasar Tradisional
market.description: Pasar tradisional ramai tempat pertukaran hasil panen, kerajinan tangan, dan produk desa.
market.description_en: Bustling open-air market where farmers, artisans and vendors trade fresh produce and wares.

minimarket.name: Minimarket
minimarket.description: Toko swalayan berpendingin ruangan dengan variasi produk pangan kemasan yang lengkap.
minimarket.description_en: Air-conditioned convenience store offering a wide variety of packaged consumer goods.

supermarket.name: Supermarket
supermarket.description: Pusat perbelanjaan modern yang melayani kebutuhan seluruh distrik permukiman kota.
supermarket.description_en: Modern supermarket catering to extensive commercial needs across residential districts.

restaurant.name: Restoran
restaurant.description: Rumah makan yang menyajikan hidangan lezat khas nusantara untuk warga dan pengunjung.
restaurant.description_en: Restaurant serving flavorful traditional cuisine to local residents and visiting travelers.

hotel.name: Hotel
hotel.description: Penginapan ramah dan nyaman bagi wisatawan yang ingin menikmati suasana asri kampung.
hotel.description_en: Hospitality inn welcoming tourists and business travelers enjoying the village atmosphere.

mill.name: Penggilingan Padi
mill.description: Pabrik penggilingan gabah yang memproses padi hasil panen menjadi beras putih bersih.
mill.description_en: Rice mill processing harvested raw paddy into clean, polished white table rice.

tofu_factory.name: Pabrik Tahu
tofu_factory.description: Sentra pengolahan kedelai lokal menjadi tahu putih lembut kaya gizi.
tofu_factory.description_en: Local soybean processing workshop handcrafting nutritious, tender white tofu.

tempe_factory.name: Pabrik Tempe
tempe_factory.description: Rumah produksi fermentasi kedelai menjadi tempe higienis bercita rasa gurih alami.
tempe_factory.description_en: Soy fermentation house producing hygienic, protein-dense traditional tempe cakes.

flour_factory.name: Pabrik Tepung
flour_factory.description: Pabrik penepungan jagung dan beras menjadi tepung halus untuk aneka kuliner.
flour_factory.description_en: Milling facility grinding corn and grains into fine flour for bakery and cooking uses.

food_factory.name: Pabrik Makanan
food_factory.description: Pabrik pengolahan makanan siap saji berkualitas untuk dipasarkan ke kota-kota sekitar.
food_factory.description_en: Food packaging plant crafting prepared meals and culinary goods for regional distribution.

warehouse.name: Gudang
warehouse.description: Gudang penyimpanan komoditas luas dan teratur untuk menambah daya tampung inventaris desa.
warehouse.description_en: Commodity warehouse expanding village storage capacity for agricultural crops and goods.

industrial.name: Kawasan Industri
industrial.description: Kawasan industri terpadu penyedia lapangan kerja manufaktur skala besar.
industrial.description_en: Integrated industrial park providing large-scale manufacturing jobs and high output.

sawmill.name: Pengolahan Kayu
sawmill.description: Tempat penggergajian kayu gelondongan menjadi papan material bangunan siap pakai.
sawmill.description_en: Sawmill cutting raw forestry timber into standardized planks for building construction.

school.name: Sekolah
school.description: Sekolah dasar desa untuk mencerdaskan generasi penerus kampung dengan lingkungan belajar nyaman.
school.description_en: Village school educating the younger generation within an encouraging, friendly environment.

clinic.name: Puskesmas
clinic.description: Puskesmas pelayanan kesehatan pertama bagi warga yang sakit atau membutuhkan pemeriksaan.
clinic.description_en: Community healthcare clinic providing primary medical consultations and treatment.

hospital.name: Rumah Sakit
hospital.description: Rumah sakit umum berfasilitas lengkap untuk penanganan medis tingkat lanjut dan rawat inap.
hospital.description_en: Full-service general hospital providing inpatient treatment and advanced healthcare services.

hall.name: Kantor Desa
hall.description: Kantor dan balai warga desa sebagai pusat administrasi, musyawarah, dan koordinasi kampung.
hall.description_en: Village hall and civic center serving as the hub for governance, meetings and community life.

police.name: Kantor Polisi
police.description: Pos polisi lingkungan yang menjaga ketertiban, kedamaian, dan keamanan warga.
police.description_en: Neighborhood police post safeguarding community safety, law enforcement and public order.

fire.name: Pemadam Kebakaran
fire.description: Pos pemadam kebakaran sigap yang melindungi pemukiman warga dari bahaya kebakaran.
fire.description_en: Emergency fire station ready around the clock to safeguard structures and citizens.

park.name: Taman Kota
park.description: Taman hijau teduh dengan pepohonan rindang tempat warga bersantai dan melepas penat.
park.description_en: Shaded green public park with lush trees where villagers relax and families socialize.

library.name: Perpustakaan
library.description: Perpustakaan desa tempat membaca buku, menambah wawasan, dan ruang belajar bersama.
library.description_en: Village library providing books, educational resources and study spaces for community members.

road.name: Jalan Tanah
road.description: Jalan tanah yang menghubungkan bangunan ke balai desa dan membuka akses pemukiman.
road.description_en: Dirt pathway connecting buildings to the village hall and opening neighborhood access.

asphalt.name: Jalan Aspal
asphalt.description: Jalan beraspal mulus yang memperlancar mobilitas warga dan distribusi hasil bumi.
asphalt.description_en: Smooth paved asphalt road facilitating rapid mobility and efficient cargo transport.

highway.name: Jalan Raya
highway.description: Jalan arteri kota berkapasitas tinggi untuk mempercepat pergerakan perdagangan antar distrik.
highway.description_en: High-capacity urban highway expediting commerce and transit across sprawling districts.

bridge.name: Jembatan
bridge.description: Jembatan penghubung yang melintasi sungai untuk membuka akses ke seberang wilayah.
bridge.description_en: Sturdy bridge spanning the river to connect isolated riverbanks and expand accessible territory.

terminal.name: Terminal
terminal.description: Terminal transportasi umum tempat angkutan pedesaan dan bus kota menaikkan penumpang.
terminal.description_en: Public transit terminal where rural minibuses and city transit buses serve commuting residents.

station.name: Stasiun
station.description: Stasiun kereta api penghubung kampung dengan jaringan rel kota besar untuk logistik massal.
station.description_en: Railway passenger and freight station connecting the township to regional metropolitan rail lines.

power.name: Pembangkit Listrik
power.description: Pembangkit listrik desa untuk menyuplai energi penerangan malam dan mesin produksi industri.
power.description_en: Municipal power station supplying dependable electricity for night lighting and machinery.

water.name: Pengolahan Air
water.description: Instalasi pengolahan air bersih yang menyalurkan pasokan air higienis ke rumah dan sawah.
water.description_en: Water treatment and distribution facility piping hygienic clean water to homes and farms.

feed_mill.name: Pabrik Pakan
feed_mill.description: Pabrik pengolahan biji jagung dan dedak menjadi pelet pakan bergizi untuk ternak.
feed_mill.description_en: Feed mill formulating corn and grain byproducts into nutrient-rich livestock pellets.
